comingLast.roast: all square with Golden at the bottom - somebody has to blink (or wipe)
level with Webber at the bottom - the blue balls may need a countback
tied with Webber - two men, two blue balls, maths pending
his round is over, his sweating is not - 1 above the line
finished 3 above Webber - close enough to keep his speech drafted
done and dangling 3 above the blue balls - do not jinx it
3 points clear from the bar - watching Webber like a hawk with a beer
in with a 4-point moat - drawbridge stuck halfway up
in the clubhouse 4 clear - his card is safe, his pride pending
in on 4 above the drop - his shout if he survives, tradition says
